Design Notes — Identity Lock

  • Silver-white hair · amber-gold eyes — never blue, never black.
  • White + lavender + gold lotus kimono; gold is warm, never chrome.
  • Nine white tails + warm red-orange kitsunebi flame.
  • Keep the reference's soft dreamy glow, bloom and painterly finish — never flat studio.
  • Pure Edo fantasy; no modern tech.
